definitions.explanation: The way in which things follow one another.

examples.japanese: {順序|じゅんじょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}って→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
{順序|じゅんじょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{間違|まちが}っている→間違う：03036_machigau⟧。
⟦アルファベット→アルファベット：10709_arufabetto⟧{順序|じゅんじょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧。

notes:
{順序|じゅんじょ} refers to the logical or prescribed order in which things should be done or arranged. The kanji are ⟦{順|じゅん}→順：03342_jun⟧ (order/sequence) + {序|じょ} (preface/beginning).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {順序|じゅんじょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to follow the proper order
- {順序|じゅんじょ}⟦{立|だ}てて→立てる：01196_tateru⟧: in an orderly manner, systematically
- {順序|じゅんじょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{逆|ぎゃく}→逆：02649_gyaku⟧: in reverse order
- {順序|じゅんじょ}⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧: in good order, methodically
- {順序|じゅんじょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間違|まちが}える→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧: to get the order wrong

CONTRAST WITH SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{順番|じゅんばん}→順番：03283_junban⟧: one's turn or position in a queue (⟦{順番|じゅんばん}→順番：03283_junban⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧ = to wait one's turn)
- {順序|じゅんじょ}: the logical sequence of steps or arrangement
- ⟦{手順|てじゅん}→手順：05452_tejun⟧: procedure, the specific steps in a process
- ⟦{順|じゅん}→順：03342_jun⟧: order, ranking (often used with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: ⟦{順|じゅん}→順：03342_jun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ = in order)
